Job Title: AI Application Security Engineer
 
 
 Job Position: AI Application Security Engineer 
 
 Role Summary
 The AI Application Security Engineer at NXP Semiconductors will be responsible for securing AI-powered applications, APIs, Generative AI (GenAI) solutions, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems deployed across enterprise and engineering environments. This role focuses on securing the application layer of AI systems, including authentication and authorization flows, prompt handling, API integrations, data access patterns, session management, and secure interaction with enterprise systems.

The AI Application Security Engineer will work closely with application development teams, AI engineering teams, enterprise security, and architecture teams to ensure AI applications are designed, developed, and deployed securely in alignment with NXP security standards and secure software engineering practices.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience in Application Security, secure coding, API security, cloud-native applications, and modern AI application architectures, with understanding of AI-related risks such as prompt injection, insecure outputs, data leakage, insecure plugins, and retrieval poisoning.

This role will support secure AI application development, architecture reviews, AI application security testing, and implementation of scalable application-layer security controls to enable secure enterprise AI adoption.
 Your Opportunity
 NXP is a global player in Semiconductor industry, and security is an essential and integral part of our business.
 
 Job Responsibility
 Conduct application security assessments and secure design reviews for AI-powered applications and GenAI solutions
 Review AI integrations involving APIs, plugins, RAG pipelines, vector databases, and enterprise applications
 Evaluate risks related to prompt injection, insecure outputs, data leakage, insecure APIs, and retrieval poisoning
 Support secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC) practices for AI applications and AI-enabled development workflows
 Collaborate with engineering teams to implement secure coding practices, application-layer controls, and secure authentication and authorization mechanisms
 Support AI application penetration testing, API security testing, and remediation activities
 Assist with validating secure use of AI coding assistants and AI-enabled development tools
 Support implementation of controls aligned with NIST AI RMF, OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, and secure application engineering practices
 
 Job Qualification
 Desired Education
 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Cybersecurity, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field
 Advanced degrees such as Masters are preferred
 
 Professional Experience
 5+ years of experience in Cybersecurity, Application Security, Runtime Security, or related engineering roles
 2+ years of experience supporting or securing AI/ML/GenAI applications or platforms
 Experience with secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC), security testing, and cloud-native security practices
 Experience with AI/ML platforms, APIs, orchestration frameworks, or AI-assisted development environments
 Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure
 
 Technical Skills
 Understanding of AI/ML/GenAI concepts including LLMs, RAG architectures, APIs, vector databases, and AI-assisted applications
 Knowledge of application security principles including secure coding, API security, authentication and authorization, and tenant isolation
 Knowledge of AI-related attack vectors including prompt injection, insecure outputs, insecure plugins, and retrieval poisoning
 Familiarity with OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, OWASP ASVS, MITRE ATLAS, and NIST AI RMF concepts
 Knowledge of cloud-native application security, container security, IAM, secrets management, and software security principles
 
 Soft Skills
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
 Excellent communication and collaboration abilities
 Ability to manage multiple initiatives in a fast-paced environment
 
 Certifications (Preferred)
 AI/ML-related and cybersecurity certifications are considered a plus

In addition, NXP will provide reasonable accommodations for otherwise qualified disabled individuals.
